newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 634,000 tonnes in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 634,000 tonnes in Jan.

text.p: Brazilian firms contributing data to the Brazilian Vegetable Oils Industries Association (ABIOVE) crushed 634,000 tonnes of soybeans in January, down from 938,000 in December, ABIOVE said.
Total crushings in the 1996/97 marketing year (February/January) were 18.54 million tonnes. ABIOVE estimates the data it receives represents between 91 and 93 percent of total Brazilian crushings.
As well as using domestic soybeans, Brazil imported a total of 1.1 million tonnes between February and January, Abiove said.
The January figure left industry stocks at 350,000 tonnes, down from 750,000 tonnes at the end of December.
Crushings last year in January when contributing companies represented 100 percent of the sector reached 991,000 tonnes, according to ABIOVE statistics.
Soybean stocks at the end of the month in 1996 were 1.59 million tonnes.
